segments.title: Hype Train Derailment: Leprechauns, Bugs Bunny, and the Scum Goal
segments.notes: Pre-show chaos featuring Hype Train's trap-beat freestyle, Pepito claiming leprechaun heritage, a scum goal requiring Pepito to sing a love song to cheese, and an unhinged Bugs Bunny interview where the rabbit threatens to kill Hype Train with Acme dynamite and claims to be Crum's father.

segments.title: Double Vagina, Two Boyfriends: Cheating or Anatomy?
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple covers the Daily Star story on Annie Charlotte, a woman with uterus didelphis who dates two men simultaneously using separate vaginas. Case, Jeff, and chat debate whether undisclosed dual partnerships constitute cheating. Kendelle walks through with her son; copper coil IUD mentioned.

segments.title: Hole Claim Theory vs. Mutual Expectations
segments.notes: Munch argues cheating is defined by 'claimed holes' and the boyfriends only claimed one vagina each; Case argues cheating violates mutually agreed expectations. Munch references Beyblade Tournament momentum. Poll leans toward Munch; Munch exits claiming victory.

segments.title: Tucker Carlson Duped by Fake Kate Middleton Whistleblower
segments.notes: Liliana joins to cover British YouTubers George and Archie pranking Tucker Carlson with a fake Kensington Palace staffer who claimed the Mother's Day photo was taken at Christmas. Tucker's team praised the interview and planned to air it.

segments.title: Case Blackwell Therapy: Pito, Buttholes, and Starcraft
segments.notes: Case visits Dr. Chath next door. Session derails into Pito's butthole fixation, a two-vagina paradox riddle, Case's Twitter 'presence,' and Starcraft commentary. Dr. Chath's final advice: 'breath.'

segments.title: Trump's $454M Appeal Bond Crisis
segments.notes: Chet joins for Trump's inability to secure a $454M appeal bond in the New York fraud case. Lawyers cite practical impossibility; Chubb insured the $91.6M Carroll bond but declined the larger one. Case and Chet speculate on 'adult sons' music genres and Koch heir parallels.

segments.title: NVIDIA Blackwell AI Chip Shares Case's Surname
segments.notes: Crum commandeers the broadcast (trigger: 'AI') to cover NVIDIA's GB200 Blackwell platform announcement. Crum jokes about Intel 'Crum processor,' suffers heartburn spike, and notes Blackwell is a platform not a chip. Case is legally dead for a fraction of a second.

segments.title: Chuck E. Cheese Fargo Closure; Pepito's Cheese Love Song Finale
segments.notes: DJ Newsic reports permanent closure of Fargo Chuck E. Cheese (effective March 17, 2024) with a mournful auto-tuned ballad. Pepito ejects to the roof and delivers a dramatic R&B love song to cheese. Raid to Bruce Green.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored full broadcast; navigated Hype Train chaos, double-vagina debate, Tucker prank, therapy, Trump bond crisis, and NVIDIA Blackwell namesake collision.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Claimed leprechaun heritage; accepted scum goal to sing love song to cheese; delivered dramatic roof-top cheese ballad at close.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Emerges from crawlspace claiming to be a leprechaun who lived at the end of a rainbow.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Freestyled trap beat, threatened Bugs Bunny with Acme weaponry, declared 'I'm a toilet' and 'I'll never die' before running out of hype.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Covered the two-vagina story; revealed two Filipino sons; debated cheating definition with Case and Munch.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Brief walk-through with son Andrew; mentioned copper coil IUD during contraceptive coil discussion.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued cheating requires 'claimed holes'; referenced Beyblade Tournament momentum; claimed poll victory and exited.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-hosted Tucker Carlson prank segment; teased Case about 'naughty' sex-story bias; left for therapy.

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: therapist. Conducted session derailed by Pito butthole fixation, vagina paradox riddle, and Starcraft; prescribed 'breath.'

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Joined for Trump bond analysis; pivoted to NVIDIA Blackwell announcement when Crum triggered 'AI' protocol.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Commandeered broadcast for NVIDIA Blackwell story; referenced Intel 'Crum processor' joke; suffered acute heartburn episode.

storylines.beat: [1:01:21] Munch references Beyblade Tournament momentum: 'Like a Beyblade, that top can only spend for so long. And now I'm topping you.'

lore_notes.fact: Pepito claims to be a leprechaun who lived at the end of a rainbow.
Scum goal established: Pepito must sing a love song to cheese.
Hype Train declares war on Bugs Bunny with Acme dynamite and military hardware.
Bugs Bunny (guest) claims to be Crum's father — 'That's Cannon.'
Jeff Ripple reveals he has two Filipino sons.
Kendelle confirms she has a copper coil IUD.
Munch explicitly references the Beyblade Tournament storyline.
Crum appears on-air for the first time this episode, triggered by the word 'AI'.
Crum jokes about Intel 'Crum processor' from skin shavings on his CPU.
Crum reveals a condition: 'temperature of my heart skyrockets' requiring focus to bring down.
NVIDIA names new AI platform 'Blackwell' — same as Case's surname; Case denies sign-off.
Chuck E. Cheese in Fargo permanently closed effective March 17, 2024; gift cards non-refundable.
Pepito performs dramatic R&B love song to cheese from roof satellite room.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with a Hype Train derailment featuring a leprechaun-claiming Pepito and a homicidal Bugs Bunny, then pivoted to a philosophical debate on whether a woman with two vaginas dating two men constitutes cheating. Munch's 'claimed hole' theory carried the poll. Liliana exposed Tucker Carlson's interview with a fake Kate Middleton whistleblower, Case endured a therapy session derailed by butthole fixation, and Chet analyzed Trump's $454M bond crisis. Crum commandeered the broadcast for NVIDIA's Blackwell AI platform — sharing Case's surname — before DJ Newsic mourned the Fargo Chuck E. Cheese closure and Pepito closed with a roof-top cheese love song.
